subject: BrightCart - AWS Marketplace private offer & unit price mapping
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: John Doe <john.doe@brightcart.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-12T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Recap & next steps — BrightCart marketplace private offer unit pricing

Hi John,

Thanks for the time today — good conversation on BrightCart's expected traffic patterns and procurement constraints. Quick recap and a proposal for next steps so we can get a private offer scoped on the AWS Marketplace: 

Summary from call:
- Expected token volumes: 250M tokens/month initial, ramping to ~1.2B tokens/month over 12 months (peak seasonal).
- Primary usage: customer-facing chat + embedding lookups (approx. 70% gen tokens, 30% embed tokens).
- Procurement channel: AWS Marketplace private offer preferred (procurement team requires marketplace PO).
- Budget range: $15k–$45k/month starting; target economics need to be around $X/1M tokens to fit internal ROI targets.

Unit economics note (high level):
- Redwood hosted list unit price (example baseline): $15 / 1M gen tokens (hosted API) — this is illustrative and depends on model/quantization.
- Marketplace private offer needs to reflect marketplace fees and reseller margins. Typical Marketplace surcharge we see is ~10–20% depending on terms.
- For BrightCart target budget (~$45k/month cap), to cover 1.2B tokens/month the unit needs to be roughly $37.50 / 1M tokens — which implies a committed discount is required.

Attachments: I attached a simple pricing map (brightcart-pricing-map.xlsx) that shows how list vs. private-offer unit pricing and commit tiers map across AWS/GCP/Azure.

Next steps I propose:
1) Please confirm a realistic committed monthly volume for 12 months (we used 250M -> 1.2B ramp).
2) I will draft an initial private offer unit price grid for AWS Marketplace that includes commit tiers and estimated surcharge.
3) BrightCart procurement to confirm required billing/legal clauses so we can include them in the PO template.
4) I'll loop in Marketplace ops to start the private offer setup and share the DocuSign/PO link.

If that looks right, can you confirm commit volume and the procurement contact?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123

From: John Doe <john.doe@brightcart.com>

Date: 2026-05-12T16:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — BrightCart marketplace private offer unit pricing

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- The 250M/mo is conservative for the first 3 months. We expect 600M/mo by month 4 and the 1.2B number is our Q4 peak estimate.
- Embeddings are billed at a different unit in our model; for planning assume 30% of tokens priced at the embedding unit.
- Procurement contact is Lisa Park (lisa.park@brightcart.com). She will own the marketplace PO process and MOUs.
- On budget: leadership wants target ~$20–$25 / 1M tokens blended (post-marketplace). They asked if you can propose a committed-tier pricing to get us in that range.

Can you share the mapping you mentioned that shows how a listed Redwood unit price translates to an AWS private-offer customer price (including marketplace fees / any reseller uplift)? Also include how Dedicated vs Hosted affects unit economics if we need reserved capacity.

I'll loop Lisa on the next reply.

Thanks,
John
Head of Integrations | BrightCart
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: John Doe <john.doe@brightcart.com>, Lisa Park <lisa.park@brightcart.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-13T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — BrightCart marketplace private offer unit pricing

Hi John + Lisa,

Looping Lisa — welcome. Per John's ask, attached is a concise unit-price mapping (brightcart-pricing-map.xlsx) and a short doc with AWS private offer steps (aws-private-offer-steps.pdf). Key points from the mapping: 

Price mapping example (illustrative):
- Redwood hosted list price (baseline): $15 / 1M gen tokens, $4 / 1M embed tokens.
- Marketplace fee and handling: AWS typically applies a marketplace surcharge; for private offers expect ~10% marketplace fee + any reseller uplift.
- To deliver a blended customer unit of $22 / 1M tokens (post-marketplace), we would propose private-offer unit of ~$20 / 1M tokens on the Redwood PO side which, after ~10% marketplace fee, lands at $22. 
- For high commit tiers (>= 500M/mo), we can push Redwood unit to $12 / 1M gen tokens (after commitment discount) which maps to ~$13.20 / 1M post-marketplace. Embedding units compress similarly.

Dedicated vs Hosted:
- Hosted (Redwood-managed): lowest operational friction; list pricing applies.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): better unit economics at very high sustained volumes (we can offer additional discounts for 12mo reserved pools), but it requires procurement coordination for capacity and possibly a separate infra SOW.

What I recommend for BrightCart given your ramp:
- Start with a Hosted private offer with 12-month commit and tiered unit pricing that steps down at 250M, 500M, 1B tokens.
- Include an escape clause for capacity / SLA review after month 3 with the option to evaluate Dedicated if utilization stays >70% for 2 consecutive months.

Next actions for us (we will):
- Draft a private-offer unit price grid based on the confirmed commit volumes (I will share v1 by EOD 5/14).
- Share a sample private-offer agreement and PO template for Lisa to review.
- Start intake with Marketplace ops once Lisa confirms procurement details.

Lisa — can you confirm the legal/billing contact and any required MSA/clauses that must appear on the PO?

Thanks,
Marissa

Hi Lisa — great, thanks for timeline. Our marketplace ops lead is Rafael Mendes (rafael.mendes@redwood.ai). I'll send v1 of the unit-price grid and the MSA + PO template by EOD today. 

Quick preview of the v1 pricing grid (blended examples):
- Tier A (0–249M/mo): Redwood unit $18 / 1M gen tokens -> AWS private-offer price ~ $19.80 / 1M (10% fee)
- Tier B (250–499M/mo): Redwood unit $14 / 1M gen tokens -> AWS private-offer price ~ $15.40 / 1M
- Tier C (500–999M/mo): Redwood unit $12 / 1M gen tokens -> AWS private-offer price ~ $13.20 / 1M
- Tier D (>=1B/mo): Redwood unit $10 / 1M gen tokens -> AWS private-offer price ~ $11.00 / 1M

These are illustrative; final grid will reflect embed vs gen split and any one-time setup credits. If post-marketplace blended target is $20–$25 / 1M as leadership requests, Tier B/C should put you in range depending on embed mix and negotiated fees.

I'll attach the files and circle back after Rafael confirms marketplace intake steps.

Best,
Marissa
